title: Digital Podcast with Biswajit Linkan
author: Digital Podcast with Biswajit Linkan
description: Welcome to this new DIGITAL PODCAST. I am your host & friend, Biswajit, a 23 YY CS Engineer, turned into a Digital Marketing Practitioner, helping brands & Businesses to Grow. The reason, behind starting this podcast is to share whatever knowledge & skills I have about this Digital World, I'll try my best to share those. Lastly, I want to thank each one of you, to invest your precious time, to listen to my Podcast.
